title: Highest temperature in London on July 26?

eventMetadata.context_description: Latest Met Office guidance and ensemble consensus, including ECMWF runs, drive the tight clustering around 25–26°C by forecasting a maximum of 25°C for London on July 26 under persistent high pressure.
